csv_project_name: A/E Service for Wilbur Hall Technology Lab Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: State University of New York at Oswego is interested in receiving qualifications from experienced design firms to provide architectural and engineering services to complete the unfinished renovations to Wilber Hall that were part of the then School of Education Renovation Plan in 2010-2017. Specifically, the final phase of the project, Phase 4: Wilber Hall North Wing which was never completed. Phase 4 of the original renovation plan thus serves as the blueprint for the current plan, which includes renovations to the following spaces: Wilber 160 - Polymers Laboratory Wilber 163 - Metals Laboratory Wilber 165 - Future site of the Construction Systems Laboratory (currently the defunct Advanced Wireless Systems Research Center)
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Hazardous Waste Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
